reaction: The distinction between movement and restraint is a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the bone matrix was most worthwhile: the planned comparison connects collagen's toughness and mineral's resistance to compression, then adds living cells and vessels in distinct locations.

leastWorthwhile.text: The capsule-and-bone assembly was clear but somewhat predictable after the separate components had been constructed.

surprise.text: The lineage plan distinguished matrix-producing osteoblasts from osteocytes embedded in the matrix, with processes extending through tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the lineage strip names mesodermal and mesenchymal precursors without explaining those terms.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how muscles act on the supported joint; the structural comparisons and cutaway plans made this chapter worthwhile.
